instruction.text: Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.

semantic_contract: Use all the number pieces to form the largest possible number, read from left to right along world +X: the most significant digit goes on the pad furthest toward world -X, on the side of the table where the left arm is mounted, and each piece must be centred on its own pad.
Lay every piece flat so the number reads correctly from the robot's side of the table, with the top of each numeral pointing toward the far edge (world +Y).
Both arms must be back at the poses they held when the episode reset, at the same instant that everything else in this contract is true.
